declaredParameters.indexRule: Each located point is indexed to the H3 cell containing it at the stated resolution, by latitude and longitude. The cell boundary returned is h3’s own boundary for that cell.
declaredParameters.sparseRule: A cell holding fewer than 2 points is omitted from the output entirely rather than returned with a small count, so its points are not represented at all. The number of omitted cells is reported.
declaredParameters.orderRule: Kept cells are ordered by their H3 index as a string.
declaredParameters.semantics: Occupancy is not an anonymity guarantee. A minimum of two means no cell in the output holds exactly one point; it does not mean an individual cannot be identified from a cell plus anything else a reader knows.
